from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486287/attempts/1eb91fd6574841ae8e00d1bb94d07e69/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {v: (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v in (1, 2)}
    r1, c1 = points[1]
    r2, c2 = points[2]
    sr = 1 if r1 > r2 else -1
    sc = 1 if c1 > c2 else -1
    p = (r2 + sr, c2 + sc)
    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
    if abs(c1 - c2) > abs(r1 - r2):
        k = (p[0] - r1) // dr
        meet = (r1 + k * dr, c1 + k * dc)
        for x in range(min(p[1], meet[1]), max(p[1], meet[1]) + 1):
            out[p[0]][x] = 3
    else:
        k = (p[1] - c1) // dc
        meet = (r1 + k * dr, c1 + k * dc)
        for y in range(min(p[0], meet[0]), max(p[0], meet[0]) + 1):
            out[y][p[1]] = 3
    for step in range(1, k + 1):
        out[r1 + step * dr][c1 + step * dc] = 3
    return out
'''
file_path = program_dir / 'task-356a179b.py'
file_path.write_text(source)
print(file_path)

import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', file_path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def make_grid(h,w,p1,p2):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    g[p1[0]][p1[1]]=1; g[p2[0]][p2[1]]=2
    return g
def marks(g): return {(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3}

 (make_grid(13,12,(10,1),(3,11)), {(4,c) for c in range(7,11)}|{(9,2),(8,3),(7,4),(6,5),(5,6)}),
 (make_grid(15,12,(13,8),(1,1)), {(r,2) for r in range(2,8)}|{(8,3),(9,4),(10,5),(11,6),(12,7)}),
 (make_grid(15,16,(12,3),(1,6)), {(r,5) for r in range(2,11)}|{(11,4)}),
]
for i,(g,e) in enumerate(demos,1):
